book.title: The Eternal Heir
book.subtitle: A Dark, Courtly Vampire Succession Thriller in Contemporary Berlin
book.description:
Ava thought vampires belonged in books—until she woke up without a heartbeat.

Abducted into the Line, a secret European aristocracy of the Risen, Ava is told the impossible: her mother was the lost heir, and Ava is next. The last.

They don’t want her safe. They want her crowned.

As an underground coronation approaches beneath palaces and locked estates, Ava is pushed through brutal rituals and relentless training to control her craving and the strange power in her mind. Her handler—Jean-Pierre, called Jae—teaches her to survive… while keeping secrets that cut too close to the truth.

Helene, a ruthless leader with a revolution in her teeth, intends to use Ava as a weapon to topple the regime from within. The Line intends to use her as a symbol to keep ruling for eternity.

Caught between factions, betrayal, and a hunger that feels like intimacy, Ava must decide who to trust before the coronation becomes a massacre—and her crown becomes a cage.

positioning.title: Genre Positioning & Market Fit
positioning.subtitle: Adult paranormal vampire court-intrigue thriller with a dark romance undercurrent in a contemporary European setting
positioning.description: Positioned as upmarket-leaning commercial adult paranormal/supernatural fiction, the project blends vampire mythology with dynastic succession politics, coercive captivity/training, and a coup-thriller engine. Its strongest market lane is "vampire power-structure intrigue" (secret immortal governance, rituals/oaths, feeding ethics, surveillance, and faction warfare) with a sensual-but-low-explicitness romantic tension between heroine and handler/mentor. Berlin/Potsdam specificity (Sanssouci/Neues Palais, underground coronation chambers, hidden estates) and a matriarchal ruling system differentiate it from more US/UK-centric paranormal romance, while cliffhanger-forward pacing and cinematic set pieces support bingeable series positioning.

moodAndTone.title: Mood & Tone Profile
moodAndTone.subtitle: Gothic, claustrophobic, conspiratorial, and sensual—driven by dread, betrayal, and hard-won resolve
moodAndTone.description: The prevailing mood is ominous and tightly wound: locked rooms, wet-stone corridors, candlelit ritual grandeur, and authoritarian control create claustrophobia and dread. Tone oscillates between grim urgency (abduction, coercion, torture threats, coup violence) and seductive menace (feeding as intimacy, entrancement/control training, morally fraught attraction). The emotional experience trends toward tension and unease with spikes of grief and anger, offset by intermittent empowerment beats (competence/training progress, "badass" self-assertion) and a small but meaningful thread of hope anchored in human connection.

opportunities.opportunity: Adult vampire court-intrigue set specifically in contemporary Germany (Berlin/Potsdam) with grounded, location-forward set pieces.
opportunities.rationale: Many vampire romantasy and paranormal titles default to Anglo-American settings or generalized European backdrops; explicit Berlin/Sanssouci texture is a standout hook.
opportunities.potentialImpact: Clearer visual branding and ad targeting ("Berlin vampire court"), improved memorability in a crowded vampire resurgence, and stronger cross-media pitchability.

opportunities.opportunity: Technique-driven "training arc" within adult vampire politics (control/entrancement + feeding ethics) rather than only romantic bonding or horror survival.
opportunities.rationale: Competence progression is highly bingeable and underused in adult vampire court narratives; it also supports series structure and episodic marketing beats.
opportunities.potentialImpact: Higher series retention/read-through and stronger positioning to readers who like skill progression, strategy, and "how it works" supernatural rules.

opportunities.opportunity: Matriarchal succession + reproductive/coercion implications handled as political stakes (not just lore dressing).
opportunities.rationale: Matriarchal vampire governance is rarer than patriarchal covens; making succession mechanics central creates a distinct political-thriller identity.
opportunities.potentialImpact: Differentiation within vampire romantasy; stronger discussion/viral potential around power, autonomy, and institutional control.

underservedAudiences.audience: Adult readers who want dark vampire romance tension without high explicitness, but with high plot intensity and moral ambiguity.
underservedAudiences.whyUnderserved: Vampire romance often polarizes into either explicit dark romance or lighter paranormal; fewer titles emphasize low-explicit sensuality alongside coup-level intrigue and coercive stakes.
underservedAudiences.potential: Large crossover potential between romantasy, paranormal romance, and thriller readers—especially in audio and serial-adjacent consumption patterns.

underservedAudiences.audience: Readers seeking LGBTQIA+ inclusive vampire court politics that are not strictly YA and not strictly horror.
underservedAudiences.whyUnderserved: Inclusive representation is common in some fantasy spaces, but adult vampire-aristocracy political thrillers with romance undercurrent are less consistently inclusive in mainstream positioning.
underservedAudiences.potential: Strong word-of-mouth potential in online communities and book social platforms; supports broader audience reach without changing core genre promise.

personas.name: Maya Chen
personas.description: A binge-reading, trope-savvy adult fantasy/paranormal reader who loves court politics, secret societies, and morally complicated romance. Maya is drawn to stories where a reluctant heroine is forced into power, learns the rules through training, and turns captivity into defiance—especially when the setting feels real and specific (Berlin nightlife, palaces, hidden tunnels).

demographics.location: Toronto, Canada (globally minded; travels to Europe when possible)
demographics.job: Product marketing manager at a tech company
demographics.lifestyle: Urban, social on weekends, structured weekdays; alternates gym/fitness routines with late-night reading; mixes mainstream entertainment with niche online fandom spaces.

personas.coreNeeds: A high-stakes, plot-forward escape that still delivers emotional intensity: betrayal-to-defiance catharsis, a competence/training arc, and a romance thread with real consequences. She wants immersive world rules (oaths, feeding ethics, secrecy laws) and a heroine who fights to keep her identity while being pressured into a role.
personas.fears: A romance that romanticizes coercion without acknowledging it; inconsistent rules around power/feeding/control; a rushed ending that doesn’t pay off the coup/coronation setup; trauma content handled without emotional truth. She’s fine with dread and moral unease, but wants the narrative to be self-aware about captivity/handler dynamics.
personas.values: Autonomy, consent awareness, loyalty, chosen/found family, resilience, justice over tradition, accountability for power.
personas.psychologicalMotivations: Maya uses dark, conspiratorial stories to metabolize real-world anxieties about institutions and control. The book’s claustrophobic governance and succession politics scratch her need for pattern-finding (who’s lying, who benefits), while the training arc and emerging resolve provide restoration through agency and mastery.

personas.whyThisBookAppeals: It matches Maya’s favorite blend: dark, courtly vampire politics plus a bingeable coup/coronation countdown. The Berlin-and-palace specificity (Sanssouci/Neues Palais, tunnels, clubs, surveillance) is a differentiator she’ll remember. Ava’s coerced initiation—training in control/entrancement and feeding ethics—hits Maya’s competence-progression itch, while the Jae/Jean-Pierre connection provides sensual tension without dominating the plot (low heat, implied). The found-family anchors (Julia, select relatives) offer a thin but meaningful line of hope amid dread and betrayal.
personas.readingGoals: To feel transported into an ominous, rule-bound world; to ride escalating tension and cliffhangers; to experience catharsis as the heroine shifts from shock and confinement to strategy and resolve; to unpack morally ambiguous relationships in a way that still preserves the protagonist’s agency.
personas.socialMedia: Active on TikTok and Instagram; consumes trope lists and ‘vibe’ edits; posts occasional spoiler-free reactions; prefers content warnings and nuanced discussions about consent/coercion. Uses Discord for deeper theory-crafting and ship debates.
personas.bookClubParticipation: Joins an online monthly dark romantasy/paranormal book club; prefers structured discussions with prompts (power dynamics, betrayal, ethics). Will recommend as a ‘talkable’ pick if triggers are clearly flagged.
personas.purchaseBehavior: Primarily ebooks for speed and price; audiobooks for immersion and pacing; buys print/special editions if the series potential is strong. Shops Amazon/Kindle, Audible, and indie bookstores for signed copies; preorders when BookTok buzz aligns with her tastes.

personas.name: Anika Patel
personas.description: An upmarket paranormal/thriller reader who comes for psychological pressure, moral injury, and institutional menace more than romance. Anika is sensitive to themes of captivity, coercion, betrayal, and identity collapse—and is drawn to stories that acknowledge trauma, grief, and recovery while still delivering page-turning conspiracy and power politics.

demographics.location: London, UK (reads globally; follows European settings closely)
demographics.job: Clinical psychologist (adult trauma and relational harm)
demographics.lifestyle: Busy, schedule-driven, values quiet decompression; intentional media choices; prioritizes ethics, boundaries, and restorative hobbies; mixes serious nonfiction with carefully selected dark fiction.

personas.coreNeeds: A smart, tense story that explores power, coercion, and survival without glamorizing harm. They want a psychologically credible protagonist response (shock, grief, anger, mistrust, hypervigilance), plus a clear arc toward meaning-making and self-determination. They also enjoy sophisticated worldbuilding that mirrors real systems: authoritarian secrecy laws, ritualized governance, and factional politics.
personas.fears: Exploitative trauma scenes for shock value; coercive romance framed as destiny without accountability; inconsistent handling of consent; violence that feels casual or unearned. They also dislike when “found family” is promised but not emotionally developed enough to counterbalance the claustrophobia.
personas.values: Psychological realism, consent and agency, justice, integrity, compassion without naivety, accountability for abusers, community care.
personas.psychologicalMotivations: Anika reads dark gothic/paranormal thrillers as a controlled way to examine fear, control, and resistance—then to experience narrative containment: rules, motives, consequences. They are especially motivated by transformation narratives that explore identity rupture (becoming Risen), moral injury (feeding/killing), and the reclamation of self after institutional betrayal.

marketing.title: Bloodline Coup: A Dark, Courtly Vampire Launch Plan
marketing.subtitle: Position a Berlin-set, matriarchal vampire succession thriller as a bingeable adult paranormal intrigue with sensual menace and a morally complex romance thread
marketing.objective: Drive sustained pre-order and launch-week sales by converting dark romance/paranormal intrigue readers through short-form video hooks, high-intent retailer ads, and serial-style cliffhanger content that highlights the forced coronation, handler/mentor tension, and coup stakes.
marketing.keyInsight: Readers who love vampire mythology and romantic tension respond fastest to a clear power-structure premise (secret court + succession) and an immediate coercive hook (kidnapped heir forced to rule), especially when packaged as bingeable, cinematic, morally thorny intrigue with a contemporary European setting and strong training/awakening progression.
howToUse: Lead with the core hook in every asset: newly turned heir + abducted into a secret vampire polity + forced coronation + coup brewing.
Keep romance positioning honest: sensual, low-explicit, subplot—sell tension, betrayal, and intimacy-as-danger rather than spice.
Use Berlin/Potsdam specificity (Sanssouci/Neues Palais, underground chambers, techno-night visuals) as a differentiator in ads and metadata.
Build a “serial momentum” content cadence: end posts/emails with a cliffhanger question or a 1-line reveal to mirror the book’s bingeability.
Anchor creative around 3 repeatable pillars: (1) Forced coronation rituals, (2) Handler/mentor control vs desire, (3) Coup/rebellion and oaths/mind-control ethics.
A/B test two market frames: 'vampire court thriller' vs 'dark paranormal romance subplot' and shift spend toward the higher ROAS angle.
Maintain trigger-aware copy in public-facing channels (captivity/coercion/violence) while emphasizing agency and resistance as the emotional payoff.
primaryKPIs: Pre-order volume and pre-order conversion rate (storefront and email-driven)
Amazon/retailer page conversion rate (sessions to purchase)
Cost per click (CPC) and click-through rate (CTR) on Meta/TikTok
Email list growth rate and welcome sequence conversion to purchase
Launch-week unit sales and rank velocity (category rank movement)
Review velocity (number of reviews in first 14 and 30 days)

campaignStructure.title: Three-Funnel Launch System (Video-Led Discovery + Retailer Intent Capture)

funnels.name: Awareness
funnels.description: Introduce the premise and aesthetic: Berlin night + secret vampiric aristocracy + kidnapped heir + underground coronation + coup. Optimize for thumb-stopping intrigue and saves/shares.
funnels.formats: TikTok/Reels short video (7–20s); cinematic teaser images; quote cards; creator-style POV skits; audiobook-style dramatized lines; mood trailers
funnels.optimisation: Optimize for video views (ThruPlay/2s/6s) and engagement; rotate 6–10 hooks; prioritize broad interest stacks and dynamic creative; measure hold rate and saves as leading indicators.

funnels.name: Consideration
funnels.description: Deepen desire with tropes, character dynamics, and stakes: reluctant heir, mentor/handler romance tension, oaths/mind control, feeding ethics, rebellion plotting, cliffhanger pacing.
funnels.formats: Carousel trope boards; 30–45s story breakdown videos; “If you like X, try this” comps; author read-aloud excerpts; landing page with blurb + trigger notes + sample chapter
funnels.optimisation: Optimize for landing page views and email sign-ups; retarget video engagers (25–95%) and profile visitors; test comp-based creative vs trope-based creative; use UTMs by pillar.

funnels.name: Conversion
funnels.description: Convert high-intent readers with direct purchase prompts, pre-order incentives, and retailer-native ads targeting vampire/paranormal and dark fantasy buyers.
funnels.formats: Meta conversion ads to retailer/landing page; Amazon Sponsored Products/Brands/Locksreen (if available); BookBub CPC (if available); email launch sequence; countdown stories
funnels.optimisation: Optimize for purchase (or outbound clicks where purchase tracking isn’t possible); retarget site visitors and email clickers; focus on strongest hook headline; use social proof (early reviews/blurbs) as soon as available.

budgetAllocation.title: Stage 1 Budget Split (Percent-Based)
budgetAllocation.breakdown: Awareness 35% (Meta + TikTok video discovery); Consideration 25% (retargeting + email lead magnet + content production); Conversion 35% (Amazon ads + Meta conversion retargeting + BookBub where viable); Partnerships/Influencers 5% (ARC shipping, creator micro-fees, giveaway).

flightSchedule.title: Recommended Flighting (8–10 Weeks Around Launch)
flightSchedule.timeline: Weeks -8 to -5: Awareness-heavy hook testing (6–10 creatives), list-building with a sample chapter. Weeks -4 to -2: Shift to consideration (tropes/character reels), start retailer ads with conservative bids, ARC outreach. Week -1: Countdown, pre-order push, retargeting intensifies. Launch Week: Conversion peak (daily emails, strongest ads, social proof). Weeks +1 to +4: Sustain with review push, price/format promos (if planned), and ‘what happens next’ cliffhanger content to support read-through.

metaTargeting.title: Meta Audience Targeting (Global English, US-First Purchasing Power)
metaTargeting.ageRange: 21–44 (test 18–20 only if content and platform policies allow; keep creative clearly adult-coded)
metaTargeting.gender: All genders; split ad sets to evaluate performance (often female-skewing for paranormal romance and court intrigue)
metaTargeting.householdIncome: Top 50% US household income (test broad vs top 50%; do not over-restrict in smaller regions)
interests: Techno music / club culture (for aesthetic targeting)
placements: Audience Network (test cautiously; exclude if low quality)
metaTargeting.devices: Mobile-first (iOS and Android); prioritize Wi-Fi placements for video; keep desktop enabled for conversion retargeting
metaTargeting.exclusions: Exclude existing purchasers where trackable; exclude under-18; exclude users who hide ads frequently; exclude interests strongly aligned with light/clean romance if mismatch reduces relevance.

lookaalikeAudiences.title: Lookalikes Built on High-Intent Reader Signals
seedEvents: Website visitors (last 30 days; exclude bounce where possible)
Add-to-cart / Initiate checkout (if using Shopify/landing page sales)
lookaalikeAudiences.refreshCadence: Refresh seeds every 14 days during pre-launch and weekly during launch week; rebuild lookalikes monthly post-launch.
prioritisationRules: Prioritize purchase-intent seeds over engagement seeds when optimizing for conversions.
Use 1% LAL for retargeting-like efficiency; scale to 2–5% only after stable CPA/ROAS.
Separate LALs by format goal (video view vs lead vs conversion) to prevent algorithm drift.
Exclude existing subscribers/purchasers from prospecting LALs to reduce waste.

messagingFramework.title: Messaging Pillars: Heirship, Hunger, and a Coup in the Dark
messagingFramework.primaryTagline: Kidnapped. Turned. Crowned—right as the coup begins.
supportingMessages: A newly transformed Risen is forced toward a coronation she never wanted—and may not survive.
A secret aristocratic vampire polity rules from shadows beneath palaces and modern cities.
A handler-mentor trains her to control craving and entrancement—while attraction and betrayal tighten the leash.
Oaths, feeding ethics, and mind games turn power into a weapon.
Berlin nights, hidden estates, and ritual grandeur collide with modern surveillance and rebellion.
keyThemes: Captivity, coercion, and the fight for agency
Sensual danger and morally ambiguous romance tension
Secrecy laws, oaths, and authoritarian control

romanceReaders.title: For Romance Readers (Tension-Forward, Low Explicitness)
romanceReaders.message: If you love slow-burn intensity without high spice: a volatile mentor/handler bond where every touch is power, every confession is suspect, and the romance thread is braided into betrayal and survival.

bookClubs.title: For Book Clubs (Ethics + Power Discussions)
bookClubs.message: A conversation-ready vampire court thriller about coercion vs consent, inherited power, secrecy laws, and what rebellion costs—set against ritual politics and contemporary Berlin.

matureReaders.title: For Mature Readers (Upmarket Intrigue + Gothic Atmosphere)
matureReaders.message: A darker, more political vampire story focused on governance, lineage, and moral compromise—gothic atmosphere, court intrigue, and an emotionally intense arc from shock to defiance.

ruralReaders.title: For Rural/Small-Town Readers (Isolation + Hidden Worlds)
ruralReaders.message: Hidden estates, forest cabins, and locked-door secrets: an immersive escape where isolation heightens danger and the heroine’s fight for freedom and identity stays front and center.

sampleCopy.title: Launch-Ready Copy Toolkit
sampleCopy.backCoverBlurb:
Ava thought vampires belonged in books—until she woke up without a heartbeat.

Abducted into the Line, a secret European aristocracy of the Risen, Ava is told the impossible: her mother was the lost heir, and Ava is next. The last.

They don’t want her safe. They want her crowned.

As an underground coronation approaches beneath palaces and locked estates, Ava is pushed through brutal rituals and relentless training to control her craving and the strange power in her mind. Her handler—Jean-Pierre, called Jae—teaches her to survive… while keeping secrets that cut too close to the truth.

Helene, a ruthless leader with a revolution in her teeth, intends to use Ava as a weapon to topple the regime from within. The Line intends to use her as a symbol to keep ruling for eternity.

Caught between factions, betrayal, and a hunger that feels like intimacy, Ava must decide who to trust before the coronation becomes a massacre—and her crown becomes a cage.

socialMediaPosts.text: She didn’t choose immortality—immortality chose her. Kidnapped into a secret vampire aristocracy and forced toward a coronation, Ava has one problem: the coup is already in motion. Dark court politics + Berlin nights + a mentor she can’t trust.
Reluctant heir. Underground coronation. Oaths that feel like chains. If you like vampire power politics, hidden lineage reveals, and morally gray alliances, this is your next binge read.
Candlelit chambers beneath a palace. A crown waiting in the dark. And a handler whose touch sparks both control and craving. Would you take the throne… if it was a trap?
Berlin at night hits different when you’re being tracked by an immortal regime. Secret doors, surveillance tension, and a heroine learning to weaponize her own hunger.
They trained her to obey. They taught her to bite. Now they expect her to rule. But Ava is done being used.

emailSubjectLines: She woke up without a heartbeat.
They kidnapped the last heir—now they want her crowned.
An underground coronation. A rebellion. A choice.
If you love vampire court politics, read this first chapter…
Launch week: the coup begins tonight.

analysisOverview.title: Analysis Overview
analysisOverview.readership: Primary: Maya Chen (“Dark Court Intrigue Binger”)—trope-savvy binge reader seeking court politics, training/competence arcs, morally fraught romance tension, and Berlin-specific atmosphere. Secondary: Anika Patel (“Psychological Gothic Thriller Reader”)—upmarket thriller/gothic reader prioritizing psychological realism, ethical handling of coercion/trauma, institutional menace, and consequential plotting (romance as subplot).
analysisOverview.classification: Positioned as upmarket-leaning commercial adult paranormal/supernatural fiction, the project blends vampire mythology with dynastic succession politics, coercive captivity/training, and a coup-thriller engine. Its strongest market lane is "vampire power-structure intrigue" (secret immortal governance, rituals/oaths, feeding ethics, surveillance, and faction warfare) with a sensual-but-low-explicitness romantic tension between heroine and handler/mentor. Berlin/Potsdam specificity (Sanssouci/Neues Palais, underground coronation chambers, hidden estates) and a matriarchal ruling system differentiate it from more US/UK-centric paranormal romance, while cliffhanger-forward pacing and cinematic set pieces support bingeable series positioning.
analysisOverview.personas: Primary: Maya Chen (“Dark Court Intrigue Binger”)—trope-savvy binge reader seeking court politics, training/competence arcs, morally fraught romance tension, and Berlin-specific atmosphere. Secondary: Anika Patel (“Psychological Gothic Thriller Reader”)—upmarket thriller/gothic reader prioritizing psychological realism, ethical handling of coercion/trauma, institutional menace, and consequential plotting (romance as subplot).
analysisOverview.marketingGuidance: Lead with the core hook: newly turned reluctant heir abducted into a secret vampire polity and forced toward an underground coronation as a coup ignites. Keep romance positioning honest (tension-forward, low explicitness; intimacy-as-danger). Use Berlin/Potsdam specificity (Sanssouci/Neues Palais, tunnels, surveillance-city texture, techno-night vibe) as a differentiator. Build serial-style momentum content (cliffhanger questions, ritual countdown beats) and A/B test framing (“vampire court thriller” vs “dark paranormal romance subplot”). Maintain trigger-aware copy (captivity/coercion/violence) while emphasizing agency/resistance payoff.

moodAndTone.title: Mood & Tone Profile
moodAndTone.subtitle: Gothic, claustrophobic, conspiratorial, and sensual—driven by dread, betrayal, and hard-won resolve
moodAndTone.description: The prevailing mood is ominous and tightly wound: locked rooms, wet-stone corridors, candlelit ritual grandeur, and authoritarian control create claustrophobia and dread. Tone oscillates between grim urgency (abduction, coercion, torture threats, coup violence) and seductive menace (feeding as intimacy, entrancement/control training, morally fraught attraction). The emotional experience trends toward tension and unease with spikes of grief and anger, offset by intermittent empowerment beats (competence/training progress, "badass" self-assertion) and a small but meaningful thread of hope anchored in human connection.
